recipe.name: Spiced Imli Margarita
recipe.description: A tangy and fiery variation on a classic Margarita blending rich tequila with sour tamarind, spicy jalapeño, and herbaceous cilantro.
steps: Muddle the jalapeños in the bottom of a shaker.
Add Camino Gold, tamarind, cilantro cordial, fresh lime juice, and ice to the shaker.
Double strain into a rocks glass filled with fresh ice.
Top up with soda and stir gently to combine.
recipe.garnish: Jalapeño wheel and a cilantro sprig
recipe.serving: Served cold over fresh ice in a salt-rimmed glass.
